parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: A list of application IDs. If specified, this operation returns information only about the specified applications.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB instance. If specified, this operation returns information only about applications associated with this instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: A list of tags. A tag is a key-value pair.
